encounter: E0157 TRAINER_ALANNAH, Ashen Woods ace (Grassy Surge + Unburden Sceptile + Mega Venusaur), cap 42
availability_audit: Chronology: Alannah is in Ashen Woods (C24), immediately after the Heat Badge and the Route 111 encounters, inside the cap-42 window. Every member's source gate is 30 or lower and every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Seaspray Cave and Seaspray Cave B1F (early, gate 14), Dewford Manor (C11-C14), Slateport Mart (C15), Rustboro Mart Linking Cord (C06), Mauville Game Corner (C18). Nothing from later in the window - no Mirage Tower or desert (C26), no Moltres (C25), no Meteor Falls fishing, no Surf (C27), no Strength area, no legendary.
plan: The anti-Grass party validated against Heidi, and the matchup is even cleaner here: all four of Alannah's Pokemon are Grass, so Charizard's Fire, Talonflame's Fire/Flying, Crobat's Poison/Flying, Weavile's Ice and Togekiss's Flying are every one at least 2x, and Gengar's Sludge Bomb is 2x into Mega Venusaur's own typing. Crobat's Taunt answers Leech Seed. Five of the six are airborne, so Grassy Terrain's Ground-damage halving and its healing both do nothing for either side of that exchange.
